Samantha Ruth Prabhu confirms pregnancy, announces maternity break

Actress Samantha Ruth Prabhu has confirmed her pregnancy and stated she will take a maternity break. She announced the news at the 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' event, indicating a return to films after the child's birth. Some reports also mention her age and a connection to her previous battle with myositis.
